messages:
Emma Chen: Hey team — ACME SI just sent a request: they need SOC2 summary, pen-test report (redacted), signed supplier questionnaire, and a presigned URL for large artifacts. Timeline: they want everything by EOD Friday. Who owns what?
Raj Patel: I can own SOC2 summary + attestations. Will pull latest certs from vault and redact account IDs.
Olivia Park: I can take the questionnaire. Need to confirm a few endpoint answers with eng.
Tomas G: Pen-test report — we have the vendor PDF but it contains client IPs and a snippet of test logs. We should redact and add an attestation letter. I can coordinate redaction with security.
Sam (partner-liaison): Thanks. Also ACME asked whether the pen scope included on-prem connectors and HSM integration. They flagged HSM as high priority.
Emma Chen: Good point — HSM was part of the scope for the last engagement?
Raj Patel: Yes, HSM and VPC connectors were in scope. I will add a brief note listing the systems covered.
Olivia Park: For the questionnaire, question 12 asks about shared keys/KMS. Can someone confirm if we have a published KMS diagram for marketplace private deployments?
Tomas G: Security will provide the diagram. I'll request the sanitized version.
Sam (partner-liaison): For artifacts storage, can we do an S3 presigned folder that expires in 14 days? ACME legal prefers short TTL.
Emma Chen: Agree. Marketplace policy prefers 7-14 days. Tomas, can security sign off on 14 days?
Tomas G: 14 days is ok with redaction + audit log. I'll also attach a short access manifest.
marketplace-bot: Note: artifact-presign-policy v2.1 requires explicit owner and retention tag. See https://internal.redwood/infrastructure/artifacts
Raj Patel: I'll prepare the SOC2 summary and upload to the presigned bucket. Example presign command I'll use:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/acme/pen-test-report.pdf --expires-in 1209600
```
Olivia Park: For the questionnaire, I'll need the exact phrase for our S3 retention answer. Raj — can you paste the final retention TTL you plan to use?
Raj Patel: Using 1209600 seconds (14 days) and adding retention_tag=partner:acme;owner=security-team in metadata.
Sam (partner-liaison): Can we also provide a short readme in the bucket describing redactions and contact for follow-up? That helps review cycles.
Emma Chen: Good idea. Keep it concise: what was redacted, who to contact, and attestation link. Sam, you own notifying ACME once upload is done?
Sam (partner-liaison): Yup, will send a DM + email with the bundle and a short checklist.
Tomas G: Pen-test redaction checklist (quick):
- remove IPs and internal hostnames
- obfuscate raw packet dumps
- redact credentials and API keys
- add attestation statement signed by security lead
I'll do this today.
Olivia Park: Q: Do we need a separate NDA-signed transfer for the full report? ACME legal hinted yes for raw logs.
Emma Chen: If raw logs are requested we need an NDA. But we shouldn't release raw logs — provide redacted report first and then handle exceptions.
Sam (partner-liaison): I'll confirm with ACME legal. If they insist on raw logs, we'll route legal + security for an exception.
Raj Patel: ETA: SOC2 summary + upload tonight (after CI job finishes).
Tomas G: ETA for redacted pen-report: tomorrow morning. I'll ping security lead for signature.
Olivia Park: I'll complete questionnaire by tomorrow lunchtime. Need one API endpoint confirmation from eng (#eng-platform).
Emma Chen: Great. Next steps: Raj uploads artifacts to presigned path, Tomas posts attestation + manifest, Olivia finalizes questionnaire, Sam notifies ACME and coordinates any NDA. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup: 
Sam (partner-liaison): Noted. I'll update the shared tracker: https://internal.redwood/partnerships/acme-evidence (added checklist items).
marketplace-bot: Reminder: attach artifact_owner and retention_tag in S3 metadata to comply with audit.
Emma Chen: Thanks everyone. If legal/ACME requests raw logs, we'll pause and escalate. Otherwise, target EOD Friday for closure.
Sam (partner-liaison): I'll loop in legal now.
Raj Patel: FYI — linking the SOC2 artifact: will be uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/acme/soc2-summary.pdf once done.
Tomas G: I'll drop the redacted pen-report link here when ready.
Olivia Park: Dropping pending eng question into #eng-platform and CCing @jen.
Emma Chen: Closing note: document everything in the tracker and include the attestation signatures. Thanks team! :rocket:
